lines.text: Men are to pray with holy hands, without anger or dissension, and women adorn themselves with long prayers.

problems.problem: Its true detail "women adorn themselves with good deeds" isn't in 1 Timothy 2:10 word for word.
Its wrong detail "women adorn themselves with long prayers" is 6 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
